thread:
olivia: Quick preflight — evening change window at 22:00 UTC. This rollout touches API (accept-header change), runtime (kv-cache TTL tweak), console (affinity fallback), and router (mux routing by session token). Need pins and any blockers now.
sam: Ack. Runtime pinned to v3.16.0. KV-cache TTL lowered in canary only (no hotpatches). Adding smoke steps to the job.
zhou: Console ack. We'll keep legacy accept-header fallback for 3 hours and enable verbose mismatch logs for 20m. We'll also run synthetic sessions during canary.
rafael: Router: enabling mux-routing that prefers token_v2 when present but preserves token_v1 for legacy clients. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> hold 30m. Will emit both tokens at canary start.
olivia: Rollback triggers: session loss >0.7% absolute, auth 401s >0.5%, p95 gen latency +120ms. Agree?
sam: Sounds good. I'll add curl /health + three prompt gens (short/mid/long) to the deploy job; abort on token decode or session drops >0.3%.
deploybot: deploy scheduled by @olivia for 22:00-window. target: runtime:v3.16.0, api:v2.12.1. canary: router.mux-routing -> 1% at t+2m.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: sam (22:00-06:00 UTC). Pager rules active.
zhou: Console metric names: console.session.mismatch and console.session.drops. Alert if mismatch >7/min. We'll post CSV of synthetic match rates every 10m.
rafael: Note: mobile webview may not send token_v2; mobile team on standby. If mobile 401s spike, we pin router flag off immediately.
olivia: Pasteable rollback quick commands:
```
# rollback runtime
/deploy rollback --service runtime --to v3.15.9 --reason "mux-routing regressions"
# rollback router flag
/deploy toggle router.mux-routing off --env prod
```
sam: Added the rollback snippets to the release notes and runbook. Also wiring grafana: router.token.mismatch, runtime.kv.evictions, console.session.errors.
deploybot: Canary started: router.mux-routing 1% at 5690012385. Monitoring groups pinged.
zhou: 8m smoke: console synthetic matches 99.6%, no auth spikes. Holding 10m then ramp to 10%.
rafael: Canary 10% -> small p95 bump for long sequences (~+80ms) but under threshold. Mobile auth clean so far.
sam: Observed a small kv eviction spike on one host pool. Investigating; not at rollback threshold. Will throttle traffic to that pool if needed.
zhou: One host had elevated mismatch; applied host-level throttle and verbose logs. Mismatch dropped to 0.4/min.
deploybot: Canary paused at 10% for a short investigation. Awaiting green signals.
olivia: Hold extended by 15m. Resume only when mismatch <1/min and p95 delta <100ms for 15m. If any alert fires, execute the rollback commands above.
oncall-bot: oncall acknowledgement recorded for sam.
rafael: Proposal when resuming: ramp to 20% (skip 25%) with a 30m hold to gather extra signals.
sam: Agreed. I'm staying on rotation through the ramp.
deploybot: Canary resumed to 20% at 5690012460. Monitoring in flight.
olivia: Thanks everyone. Update release notes with the console fallback and host-throttle steps. Closing thread unless we see issues. :thumbsup:
